title: Dile Hafif

scenes.text: Sabah durakta otobüs bekliyorsun. Elin yine telefona gidiyor.
scenes.prompt: ONE single faceless bare-headed man standing at a bus stop at dawn holding a phone, seen from the side, plain modern apartment blocks only in the background, no domes, no spires, no towers, no religious buildings

scenes.text: Oysa bu bekleyişi değerli kılacak iki kısa cümle var.
scenes.prompt: an empty bus stop shelter at sunrise with soft mist on the street, plain modern apartment blocks only in the background, no domes, no spires, no towers, no religious buildings, no people
close-up of a simple wristwatch on a bus stop bench in morning light, no people

scenes.text: Peygamber Efendimiz buyurdu: İki kelime vardır ki dile kolay, mizanda ağır, Rahman'a sevimlidir.
scenes.prompt: an antique brass balance scale glowing in warm sunrise light in a quiet room, no people
golden morning light pouring over a calm empty street with long soft shadows, plain modern apartment blocks only in the background, no domes, no spires, no towers, no religious buildings, no people

scenes.text: Otobüste, kuyrukta, asansörde. Dilin boşta kalmasın.
scenes.prompt: ONE single faceless bare-headed man sitting by a bus window at sunrise, phone in his pocket, looking outside, seen from behind

scenes.text: Bugün her beklediğinde bu iki cümleyi söyle.
scenes.prompt: ONE single faceless woman in a headscarf waiting in a short calm queue at a bakery in the morning, seen from behind, warm light

scenes.text: Bunu, her sabah yolda vakit geçiren birine gönder.
scenes.prompt: two faceless bare-headed men walking side by side to a bus stop at sunrise, seen from behind, plain modern apartment blocks only in the background, no domes, no spires, no towers, no religious buildings

hisse: İki kelime vardır ki dile kolay, mizanda ağır gelir ve Rahman'a sevimlidir: Sübhânallâhi'l-azîm, Sübhânallâhi ve bihamdihî.
caption:
Beş saniyelik iki cümle ⚖️

Beklerken geçen dakikalar boşa gitmesin. Bugün en çok nerede bekliyorsun?

Kaynak: Buhârî, Deavât 65 (6406) · Müslim, Zikr 31 (2694)
